anim_delay_tooltip: Wait in ms before the needle starts to move (default 500)
animate_duration_tooltip: Duration of the animation in ms
arc_tooltip: Thickness of the arc as part of the radius (default 0.2)
arc_width_tooltip: Thickness of the arc as part of the radius
aspect_ratio_tooltip: Height of the battery as part of its length. With padding 0: D = 0.56, C = 0.52, AA = 0.28, AAA = 0.23, AAAA = 0.19. Default: C battery
bar_size_tooltip: Thickness of the bar as part of the free space
battery_font_size_tooltip: In units of the drawing, which is 100 wide. 0 hides the text. Default 14
battery_size_tooltip: Length of the battery in px. Empty: fits the widget
canvas_units_tooltip: In units of the drawing, which is 100 wide
charging_tooltip: While this object is true, the battery shows a flash and fills again and again
color_mode_tooltip: One color: always the same color. Color of the level: the color of the level the value is in. Gradient: the colors of the levels blend into each other
dark_contrast_color: Text color on the filled part
dial_label_tooltip: Short text on the dial, e.g. "Power" or "km/h"
digits_after_comma_tooltip: Empty: as many as needed, at most two
display_mode_tooltip: Bar: a filled bar. Pointer: the levels are shown on the whole scale and a triangle points at the value
from_zero_tooltip: If the scale goes below zero, the bar starts at 0 and grows to both sides, e.g. for the power at the grid connection
gradient_tooltip: Fills the liquid with a gradient defined by the levels
help_arc: Arc with the value in its middle, also in segments like LEDs, with a marker for a target value
help_battery: Battery with its charge and a charging indicator
help_color: Half circle of colored segments with a needle
help_compass: Compass rose for a direction, e.g. of the wind, with the speed in the middle
help_linear: Horizontal or vertical bar with a scale
help_radial: Round instrument with a scale, color bands and a needle
help_rings: Up to five values as concentric rings
help_tank: Fill level of a tank or a cistern
help_water: Circle that fills with a wavy liquid
inner_radius_tooltip: Radius of the inner circle. 0.9 is 90% of the radius of the outer circle
invert_direction_tooltip: A wind direction tells where the wind comes from. With this option the needle points to where it blows (+180°)
legend_tooltip: "In the free quarter" needs rings that start at the top and leave the upper left quarter free (sweep angle up to 300°); otherwise the legend is shown beside the rings
level_color_tooltip: If not every level has a color, the colors run from the first to the last one that is set
level_stop_opacity_tooltip: From 0 to 1: 0 is transparent, 1 is opaque
level_threshold_tooltip: Position of this color in the gradient, as absolute value. The first level is always at the minimum, the last at the maximum
level_threshold_upper_tooltip: Absolute value where this level ends. The last level always ends at the maximum. Empty: the rest of the scale is shared equally
light_contrast_color: Text color on the empty part
low_battery_value_tooltip: Below this value the meter and the text get the low battery colors. In the unit of the value. Empty: 15 %
major_ticks_tooltip: Number of sections between the labeled ticks
margin_in_percent_tooltip: Space around the gauge as part of the widget size (default 0.05)
margin_tooltip: Gap between the outer circle and the liquid as part of the radius. 0.025 is 2.5% of the radius of the outer circle
medium_battery_value_tooltip: Below this value (and above the low value) the meter gets the medium color. In the unit of the value. Empty: not used
minor_ticks_tooltip: Number of small steps within one major division
name: Title
needle_size_tooltip: Length of the needle as part of the radius (default 0.55)
no_of_cells_tooltip: More than 1 draws a battery of single cells
north_offset_tooltip: Degrees that are added to the value, e.g. if the sensor does not point exactly to the north
outer_radius_tooltip: Radius of the outer circle. 1 is 100% of the radius
ring_color_tooltip: Empty: red, green, blue, orange, violet
ring_width_tooltip: Width of one ring as part of the radius
rise_animation_time_tooltip: Time in milliseconds for the liquid to rise to its new level (default 2000)
rotate_dial_tooltip: The dial turns and a fixed mark on top shows the direction, like a compass in a car
rotate_tooltip: Turns the whole scale clockwise, in degrees. 0: symmetric to the top
segments_tooltip: 0: a continuous arc. More: the arc is split into this many segments, like LEDs
show_percent_tooltip: Shows the fill level in percent below the value
size_tooltip: Diameter in px. Empty: fits the widget
speed_oid_tooltip: Optional: shown in the middle of the dial, e.g. the wind speed
sweep_angle_tooltip: How far the scale reaches around, in degrees: 180 is a half circle, 360 a full one
target_oid_tooltip: Optional: shows a marker at this value, e.g. the set point
text_size_tooltip: Relative height of the text. 1 is 50% of the radius of the outer circle
track_opacity_tooltip: The empty part of a ring is drawn in its color with this opacity
value_size_tooltip: Font size of the value as part of the radius
wave_amplitude_tooltip: Height of the waves in percent of the filling height (default 1)
wave_animation_time_tooltip: Time in milliseconds for a whole wave to pass through the circle (default 2000)
wave_frequency_tooltip: Number of whole waves across the width of the circle (default 2)
